description: Rails is a Ruby framework with clear places for routes and controllers. These API-only examples return small data replies. These 12 starter lessons use small examples and simple words. Read the result, make one small change, and try the practice question. Create a practice project with rails new school --api --skip-active-record. Enter it. Put each labelled section into its named file, then run bin/rails server -b 127.0.0.1 -p 8000. No database is needed.
versionNote: Examples use Rails 7.1 or later in API-only mode with a supported Ruby version.
whatYouWillLearn: Make a controller action with Ruby on Rails
Read query data with Ruby on Rails
Report a missing item with Ruby on Rails
Set response metadata with Ruby on Rails
learningObjectives: Make a controller action with Ruby on Rails
